mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish: expect a crisp 62 degrees at Verona City Hall. Tonight, keep your eyes on the skies at 5:47 PM for a four-minute ISS pass as it travels from over Cross Plains toward Madison.

The city is planning significant utility and road construction for 2027 and 2028. Residents are invited to a public information meeting on December 16 at City Hall to discuss these updates to streets like North Shuman and North Marietta. Also, please remember to properly dispose of fats, oils, and greases to protect our community sewer infrastructure.
There is plenty to do in Verona! Today, you can attend Yoga at Insight Wellness. Tomorrow, check out live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard or head over to Paddy Mac's for more local performances.
Regarding the recent police report, on November 4, a two-vehicle crash occurred in a parking lot on East Verona Avenue, resulting in an arrest for O W I.
Today's flavor of the day is a delicious Double Strawberry. The store is currently open and will remain open until 10:00 PM, so head over to enjoy your treat.
